verdict.rationale: Devin's docs show it accepts plain-language requests, such as Slack/Teams threads about bugs or feature requests and asks to implement new features or reproduce and fix bugs, and starts working sessions from them. The evidence does not show an explicit step that converts that intent into a scoped spec or task definition before implementation, so only the plain-language intake half of the story is clearly documented. Missing for 10: documented automatic scoping or spec/plan generation from natural-language intent, and independent hands-on corroboration that requests are scoped accurately.

support.subject: As a developer, I can describe a feature or bug in plain language and have it automatically turned into a scoped implementation task

citations.quote: Ask Devin to tackle Linear/Jira tickets, implement entirely new features, repro and fix bugs, build internal tools, and more!
Start sessions directly from conversations about bugs, feature requests, or questions.
Tagging Devin on a Slack or Teams thread about a bug you’re discussing with coworkers
